question: Should Signal native quote replies ship with `replyToMode` defaulting to `all` for eligible replies, or should the default be narrowed before this draft leaves maintainer review?
rationale: The implementation is coherent, but the default changes existing Signal reply presentation and reply/session targeting, which is a product and upgrade-safety decision rather than a mechanical code repair.

options.title: Ship default all
options.body: Accept the new default so Signal behaves like a native quoted-reply channel by default, with documented `off`, `first`, and `batched` opt-outs for users who prefer the old presentation.

options.title: Narrow the default
options.body: Change the default to `first` or `off` before merge to minimize upgrade surprise, while leaving native quote replies available through explicit config.

options.title: Hold for more live proof
options.body: Keep the draft open until a maintainer captures a fresh DM native-quote roundtrip in addition to the group proof already described.

recommendation.title: Ship default all
recommendation.body: Accept the new default so Signal behaves like a native quoted-reply channel by default, with documented `off`, `first`, and `batched` opt-outs for users who prefer the old presentation.
